title: JevNavAgent: A Single-Forward Visual Navigation Agent with Trajectory-Level RL for Gigapixel Pathology
title_zh: JevNavAgent：面向十亿像素病理图像的单次前向视觉导航智能体，采用轨迹级强化学习
abstract_en: Gigapixel whole-slide images (WSIs) exceed single-pass vision-language model (VLM) capacity at cellular resolution, while multiple instance learning relies on query-agnostic offline patching without interactive reasoning. Multi-step VLM navigation agents inspect regions on demand, yet face two bottlenecks: (1) autoregressive action decoding incurs heavy latency, throttling exploration and online multi-trajectory RL; and (2) offline distillation suffers from an existential-versus-universal stopping asymmetry between positive detection and negative exclusion, inducing thumbnail and kinematic shortcuts while leaving policies prone to passing metastases without stopping. Under the Jev (System One) paradigm, a model predicts distributions over predefined decision spaces in one forward pass (0 generated tokens) while deterministic code executes navigation. We build JevNavAgent, a 2B-parameter agent combining factorized stopping, spatial-candidate, and contextual-bilinear answer heads with overview modality dropout. We pair Stage-1 offline counterfactual trajectory alignment (mitigating depth and panning shortcuts) with Stage-2 online trajectory-level GRPO (Traj-GRPO), using decoding-free rollouts to optimize branch-level lesion discovery, in-polygon stopping, and step-wise confidence gain. On Clean Visual WSI-VQA, JevNavAgent achieves 51.57% multi-scale (50.43% terminal-step) overall and 51.39% focal accuracy, outperforming frontier VLM agents and 4B-11B open-source cascades while running nearly 12x faster than frontier APIs (5.63s vs. 66.64-70.04s). On CAMELYON16 Official Test, Traj-GRPO reaches 22.45% localization (converting 11/12, or 91.7%, of visited tumors into grounded stops) with 93.75% specificity and 69.77% slide accuracy, surpassing Stage-1 SFT under matched stopping rules alongside zero-shot budget scaling.
abstract_zh: 十亿像素全切片图像（WSI）在细胞分辨率下超出视觉语言模型（VLM）单次处理的容量，而多实例学习依赖与查询无关的离线切块，难以按需查看和交互推理。现有多步 VLM 导航智能体受限于自回归动作解码的延迟，以及离线蒸馏中的停步不对称：确诊只需找到一处病灶，排除病灶却需要充分搜索。这种不对称容易使模型依赖缩略图、浏览深度或平移模式等捷径，也可能导致模型经过转移灶却不停下。JevNavAgent 遵循 Jev（System One）范式，以 20 亿参数模型在每步单次前向中预测预定义决策空间上的概率分布，不生成任何 token，再由确定性代码执行导航。模型采用分解式停步头、空间候选头和上下文双线性答题头，并在训练时随机丢弃概览模态。训练分两阶段：先进行离线反事实轨迹对齐，再用在线轨迹级强化学习 Traj-GRPO 优化搜索分支中的病灶发现、病灶轮廓内停步和逐步置信度提升。在 Clean Visual WSI-VQA 上，模型的多尺度总体准确率为 51.57%，末步总体准确率为 50.43%，局部问题准确率为 51.39%；推理用时 5.63 秒，相比前沿 VLM API 的 66.64–70.04 秒快近 12 倍。在 CAMELYON16 Official Test 上，模型的定位率为 22.45%，特异度为 93.75%，切片级准确率为 69.77%；在访问过的 12 个肿瘤中，有 11 个实现了病灶内停步。
key_points_zh: 每个导航步骤只需一次前向计算，生成 0 个 token，由确定性代码执行动作，降低在线采样多条轨迹的成本。
离线反事实轨迹对齐抑制浏览深度和平移捷径；在线 Traj-GRPO 直接优化病灶发现、轮廓内停步及逐步置信度提升。
Clean Visual WSI-VQA 多尺度总体准确率达 51.57%，超过论文所比较的前沿 VLM 智能体和 4B–11B 开源级联系统；相比前沿 VLM API 快近 12 倍。
在 CAMELYON16 Official Test 上，已访问肿瘤的病灶内停步比例为 91.7%（11/12），但整体定位率仅为 22.45%；在相同停步规则下，Traj-GRPO 优于第一阶段监督微调。

agent-multimodal.reason: 核心贡献是让视觉智能体按需查阅全切片图像区域：以单次前向预测导航、停止和回答决策，并用在线轨迹反馈更新策略。摘要报告了量化的准确率、延迟和病灶定位结果，但未给出足以隔离各组件作用的消融证据。
